items.title: Lisa Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 22, 2021
items.q: Definitely a lot of Eric Dolphy I’d have to say, “Far Cry!” I listened to that.

ctx.x: Well there were quite a few. Sometimes it was not me but the roommate who played “Blue Trane” every morning for three months. Like there was one note in Curtis Fuller’s trombone solo that I still can’t — uh — but early Ornette stuff, “Tales of Captain Black” which is another Ornette album, actually no, it’s a co-led album with Jamaaladeen Tacuma, Roland Shannon Jackson, Ornette, and Bern Nix on guitar? No, I’m sorry, James Blood Ulmer on guitar. But also “Four and More,” Miles. You know. It’s just whatever we had…
